name: OS/2 Warp layout
description: The WarpCenter along the top and a grey window with its title in the middle around each scene: its first button opens the scene list, the second the windows, and the clock the frame's page. On a Pi or an ESP32 it is a desktop: every scene opened is a window, all running at once, with the LaunchPad and its drawer, a system menu on every window, the Window List to tile or cascade them, and OS/2's keys.
